preservedStateReinstall.disposition: Unsupported and correctly fail-closed under the current contract. Do not weaken fresh_check or enable a repair shortcut.
verifiedCodeFacts: Fresh preparation derives previousArtifacts from actual installed packages. With only Voice present, any maslow-free-ai state directory immediately rejects before service/profile or keyring inspection; keyring-only residual items also reject through existence-only checks.

Current-operation recovery rejects an absent package when that package is recorded in previousArtifacts. Intact previous/target states are supported; arbitrary removal, missing ownership and repair are not.

Successful completion writes a terminal root receipt under the fixed transaction directory, then removes the public ticket and active free-ai-security.json. No active authority or canonical last-installed-state pointer remains merely because historical archives exist.
Terminal decisions prohibit historical snapshot replay. Current quota/settings may have advanced after that receipt; an old matching key fingerprint does not authorize replacing current data.

The existing ticket/receipt model does not separately bind an absent backend's state-verifier provenance and the actually installed previous package set. Adding the absent package to previousArtifacts would misrepresent the installed baseline; omitting it leaves the retained verifier unbound.
authoritativeEvidenceNeededBeforeAnyFutu: An unambiguous protected root-owned record binding the original UID and the exact package/source/archive identity that owned the preserved state, with the exact retained archive still verified. Package cache names, user build.json, directory timestamps or selecting the newest historical receipt are insufficient.

A fresh authorized operation that distinguishes present package ownership from preserved state provenance and binds a new transaction/nonce/current recovery checkpoint. An expired or completed install ticket cannot be renewed into reinstall authority.

A canonical stopped Voice/router environment, admission barrier, owned service lock and private root/user lease; a user-owned verifier from the exact supported retained prior artifact, never an unverified target or developer module.

Private verification of the current database and current Secret Service key, current WAL/quota/settings and a new consistent snapshot. Root receives only bounded identities/hashes; old key/snapshot presence alone is insufficient.

Exact current package absence/ownership, fixed intended archives, normal pacman signature/dependency/hook policy and interruption recovery that explicitly preserves current data even if the backend remains absent.
preservedStateReinstall.minimalNextAction: First prove the existing fresh and managed native install/current-operation recovery paths with the built artifacts in an admitted disposable environment. Then characterize removal with state/key preservation and verify refusal. Supporting reinstall requires a separately reviewed preserved-state lifecycle contract and authoritative provenance selection; that extension is outside this no-schema-change investigation. Keep the current blocker until that contract exists.
focusedTestsRequired: Backend absent plus state directory: reject with bytes/permissions unchanged and no secret lookup; backend absent plus only keyring items: reject without retrieving secrets; locked/error keyring never means empty.
Missing previously recorded backend, partial ownership, manual files, unsupported historical FreeAI1 verifier and mismatched UID/archive/source remain unavailable.
After completed operation and new quota/settings/key changes, retained old receipts cannot restore old data, re-enable routes or resurrect account grants.

Any future paired reinstall proof must retain current ciphertext, quota and preferences across success, disk-full, key mismatch and interruption; no plaintext export, state deletion, migration, dependency sweep or target-capsule fallback.
Current-operation interrupted fresh undo remains separate from uninstall/reinstall after admission resumed. Do not mark one gate passed from the other.
